questions.question: Calculate total ATP from one glucose via aerobic respiration. Explain why yield is often less than theoretical

points.text: Glycolysis: 2 ATP + 2 NADH (3-5 ATP); Link: 2 NADH (5 ATP); Krebs: 2 ATP + 6 NADH (15 ATP) + 2 FADH₂ (3 ATP) = 25-30 + 4 = 29-32 ATP. Less because: proton leak, shuttle costs (glycerol-3-P shuttle vs malate-aspartate), ATP for transport
